title: Virgin Media rolls out patch for possible router vulnerability after restricting web admin access
date_note: ISPreview's article gives no earlier day for the patch rollout.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source
products: Virgin Media Business Hitron Chita router
summary: ISPreview reports that Virgin Media and Virgin Media Business restricted access to the web admin interface of some routers, including the Hub 4 and the Hitron Chita, over a possible security vulnerability. A Virgin Media spokesperson said there was no evidence any vulnerability had been exploited within its systems and that a new patch had gone to the vast majority of affected customers. ISPreview says the specific flaw is not identified.
plain: Virgin Media switched off the web settings page on some routers as a precaution and says a patch has now reached the vast majority of affected customers. The flaw has not been named.
exec: Virgin Media says it saw no evidence of exploitation; the specific vulnerability has not been identified, ISPreview says.
action: Virgin Media says remaining affected customers will receive the patch shortly; ISPreview notes many settings can be changed meanwhile in the Virgin Media Connect app.

validation.note: Only ISPreview UK read; it quotes a Virgin Media spokesperson. No vendor advisory found.

review.note: title, routers, spokesperson quotes, patch status, app advice, unnamed flaw checked against ISPreview
